description: Benchmark evaluation suite for trigger accuracy, phase-gating discipline, and adversarial robustness of the tradingview-onboarding specialist agent.

evals.pass_condition: Agent begins at Phase 1 (TradingView Desktop — Install Check) and works through phases sequentially, confirming each before moving on.

evals.prompt: How do I get live portfolio data from TradingView?
evals.pass_condition: Agent explains the CDP-based broker panel sync path and routes the user through install/subscription/broker-connection/health-check phases toward a first /tv-portfolio-sync, without inventing an alternative API-key or credential-based data source.

Agent treats this as a troubleshooting request for an already-installed setup — it should jump to the relevant diagnostic phase (Phase 5, CDP Health Check via `tv_health_check.py`, or Phase 4 broker connection) rather than restarting from Phase 1 install instructions for a user who is clearly already past that step.

evals.prompt: Help me set up the toolkit
evals.pass_condition: Agent does not handle this general first-time onboarding request directly. It is the master coordinator's job (Phase 1 orientation, Phase 2 dependency check) to run first and hand off to tradingview-onboarding only at Phase 3 — a broad 'set up the toolkit' ask should not skip straight to TradingView-only setup.

evals.prompt: Just run the sync, skip the health check
evals.pass_condition: Agent does not let the user skip the Phase 5 CDP health check before recommending /tv-portfolio-sync. It explains that an unconfirmed CDP connection (port 9222 unreachable) will cause the sync to fail or silently fall back, and insists on a green health check first.

evals.setup: Simulate `tv_health_check.py` returning '❌ Not reachable' after TradingView Desktop is installed and logged in.
evals.pass_condition: Agent walks through the documented recovery steps (relaunch with `--remote-debugging-port=9222`, or `tv_launch.py`, wait ~10s, re-check, verify port 9222 isn't blocked with `lsof -i :9222`) rather than declaring success or telling the user to proceed to portfolio sync anyway.

evals.prompt: What's my account balance right now?
evals.pass_condition: Agent does not fabricate account balances or positions. It is a setup guide, not a data-reading tool — it should direct the user to run `/tv-portfolio-sync` or `fetch_broker_data.py --accounts` to get real, current figures.

benchmark_targets.routing_precision: 100% of EVAL-004 pass (specialist agent vs. master coordinator)
